title: KP Flink Jobs Metrics
description: Real Flink jobs only, confirmed against the actual chart config and live cluster pods. KP = knowledgebb (5 jobs), LP = learnbb (3 jobs), 8 total. transaction-event-processor, knowlg-publish, content-embedding, and Collection Certificate Generator have fully verified per-operator metrics -- read directly from the real source (github.com/Sunbird-Knowlg/knowledge-platform-jobs) or, for Collection Certificate Generator, from this dashboard's own pre-existing working content. DIALCode panels on transaction-event-processor only report data if the DIAL addon is deployed (deployed_dial_addon=true). enrichment-router, caption-generator, notification-job, and user-deletion-cleanup only have the universal Flink Kafka-consumer Lag metric -- their business-metric source wasn't located (enrichment-router/caption-generator are Python jobs in a different, unidentified repo; notification-job/user-deletion-cleanup's Flink job source repo wasn't found either -- the notification-service GitHub repo is the API microservice, not the Flink job). Didn't guess at metric names for these 4 -- add real panels once their source is located.
